method: Exact transformed vertices/indices and sealed source generation/revision/filter/format/scissor are retained in GPU canonical program storage. Each tile compares full words plus actual LOAD input RGBA pixels. GPU snapshots only dirty input tiles before painting; captures full native output only after raster replay. Clean tiles restore all native AA/text/image/mesh/base pixels and generate native VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand with instanceCount0. Tests read actual GPU argument words.

coverage.variants: Release, Debug, explicit no-HarfBuzz; direct/staged; cache/off;1150/5000; bitmap and Slug; tiny image budget; raw vertex/index changes with stable AABBs, LOAD changes, texture revision at native submission, removal/clip/target-generation, overflow, CPU payload exhaustion, deliberate hash collisions and flattened dispatch

negative_control: The exact output-cache oracle compiled with frozen verified-I3 code fails at frame5:12 tile hits but0cached pixels instead of12288. Candidate source also checks native GPU indirect words under its current private-test define; old-ABI wrapper omits only that new private counter/argument inspection. Asset path is the same explicit bundled path.
limits: This is focused functional validation. Both complete project suites are running separately. General output reuse is correct but sampled resource revisions are currently conservative; value-based effect DAG/clear/copy admission remain incomplete. Analytic CPU vertex preparation, glyph source-alpha residency, groups/alpha barrier and normal production selection remain open. Function cache misses are high. Cached vector Spiral image allocations51732736B vs11362560B uncached, metadata peak35307648B vs22455680B; retain this cost, do not claim reduced VRAM or speedup. Native draw allocation/resource counters are0; global C/C++/driver CPU/allocation and actual readback-free performance/foreground gates remain open. No commit yet.
